purpose: Full-background artistic mountain candidate domain, not surveyed forest cover
area_method: 20m terrain cell corner mean elevation and corner mean finite-difference gradient; 400m2 per cell; excludes no roads/towns/water/terrain holes yet
mandatory_exclusions: outside actual rendered ground terrain and terrain holes
S3 and Kitahara conservative settlement/farm corridor 400m
building facility plaza lot parking branch and pad surfaces with margin
actual water surfaces and riverbed with margin
uncovered_intentionally: settlements agriculture facilities water and protected road corridors
uncertainty: Elevation/slope thresholds are artistic conservative selection parameters, not ecological forest classification. Existing real forests in excluded flatter areas may remain unaugmented. Existing trees are retained except independently identified submerged roots. Final candidate area must be computed after exclusions against actual mesh footprint.
